summary: The root W-TH-N refers to an idol, similar to other terms like S-N-M, '-TH-N, and '-N-N. It denotes an object of worship other than God.
lane: وَثَنٌ ذ An idol: see صَنَمٌ and عَثَنٌ and عَنَنٌ .
